title: Nvidia Stock (NVDA) Falls 4.3% After Huang Resigns as CEO (Nov 12)
summary: Nvidia (NVDA) fell 4.34% to $166.19 on Nov 12 after Jensen Huang resigned as CEO and CFO Colette Kress became interim chief executive.
body_markdown:
## Why Nvidia Stock Fell


According to the company's[announcement filed with the SEC](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001045810/000104581026000082/nvidiaannouncesceotransiti.htm) on November 12, Huang resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer and a member of the Board, effective immediately. Kress will serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer while continuing as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, and the board named Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair. The board said it has started a search for a permanent CEO and will consider internal and external candidates.


As reported by[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-following-jensen-huangs-resignation-as-ceo-allegations-of-a-third-affair-emerge-195535310.html) , the board met on Wednesday night and[decided to oust Huang](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-stock-falls-after-hours-huang-ouster-report/) , and the stock dropped as much as 13% on the news before paring losses. The exit capped days of reports about Huang's personal conduct. On Thursday, Reuters reported a further alleged relationship with an Nvidia employee, and Nvidia declined to comment, per the same live coverage.


## NVDA Stock Analysis: Supporting Factors and Risks


### Supporting Factors


- In its announcement, Nvidia said it expects operations, customer commitments and the product roadmap to continue without interruption, and board chair Harvey C. Jones said the board has full confidence in Kress and the leadership team.
- Per[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/live/nvidia-live-updates-following-jensen-huangs-resignation-as-ceo-allegations-of-a-third-affair-emerge-195535310.html) , retail investors bought a net $111 million of Nvidia in the first 30 minutes, which Vanda Research called the biggest opening on record.
- Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon said, "We aren't really worried about near-term impacts to the business," according to the same Yahoo Finance coverage.


### Risks


- Nvidia has no permanent CEO yet, and Rasgon questioned whether any new chief executive could fill Huang's role.
- The story is still developing. Rep. Brian Mast said Huang agreed to testify before Congress before Thanksgiving, according to Yahoo Finance.
- [Stocktwits](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/michael-burry-doubles-down-nasdaq-235318261.html) tied a selloff in AI infrastructure stocks to Huang's exit, which it said came amid regulatory scrutiny of Nvidia.
- Pressure is spreading to Nvidia-linked cloud providers. According to[TheStreet](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/nvidia-backed-ai-cloud-stock-234554864.html) , Nvidia-backed Nebius fell about 18% on Thursday after trimming its 2026 revenue guidance on third-party data center delays, and the selloff hit the whole neocloud group.


Nvidia will report its third-quarter fiscal 2027[financial results](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/learn/how-to-read-an-earnings-report/) on Tuesday, November 17, with an earnings call at 2 p.m. PT, according to the company's announcement.
